test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Intelligible
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Intelligible" **means capable of being understood or comprehended.
 
• The synonym for **"Intelligible" **is **"Comprehensible".**
 
• Other options like Impossible, Responsible, and Dispensable do not convey the same meaning as** "Intelligible".**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Impossible** means not able to occur, exist, or be done.
 
• **Responsible** means having an obligation to do something, or having control over or care for someone, as part of one's job or role.
 
• **Dispensable** means able to be replaced or done without; superfluous.
